subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: May cron overflow recovery silently delete the oldest quarantine archives after five retained files, or must recovery-record cleanup be explicit and doctor-owned?
rationale: The code changes persisted recovery-data retention and cannot infer whether bounded disk use outweighs preserving historic quarantine records for diagnosis and recovery.

options.title: Use doctor-owned cleanup
options.body: Keep archive rotation but preserve recovery records until a visible doctor/recovery flow can inspect or remove them.

options.title: Approve five-file runtime retention
options.body: Accept silent deletion of the oldest archives after five files as the supported recovery-data retention contract.

options.title: Land caps without rotation
options.body: Retain bounded reads and writes but remove archive-and-prune recovery until a retention design is approved.

recommendation.title: Use doctor-owned cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep archive rotation but preserve recovery records until a visible doctor/recovery flow can inspect or remove them.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly asks this person to choose the archive-retention policy, which is the only remaining substantive blocker.
